propositions: actionlint is currently scoped only to release.yml in the Makefile lint target, leaving other workflows including reconcile-bridge.yml unvalidated
An unparseable workflow (invalid GitHub Actions context in job-level env) merged undetected because actionlint coverage did not include reconcile-bridge.yml, causing a production outage
make lint must be widened to run actionlint against all .github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml} files to catch parse errors and invalid contexts before merge
zizmor security audit scope remains release.yml-only; only actionlint scope expands to all workflows
A regression test must assert actionlint runs against all workflows and fail if coverage re-narrows to release.yml only
